class.name: HIDDevice
class.brief_description: Raw access to a USB or Bluetooth HID device.
class.description: Talks to a HID device directly with its own reports, for controllers or features the joypad driver doesn't handle. Opening a controller that is also in use as a joypad works, but writing to it can interfere with the driver. [codeblock] for info in HIDDevice.enumerate(0x054C): print(info.product, " ", info.path) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Only available on Windows, macOS and Linux.

method.name: enumerate
method.description: Returns every connected HID device as a [Dictionary] with [code]"path"[/code], [code]"vendor_id"[/code], [code]"product_id"[/code], [code]"serial_number"[/code], [code]"release_number"[/code], [code]"manufacturer"[/code], [code]"product"[/code], [code]"usage_page"[/code], [code]"usage"[/code], [code]"interface_number"[/code] and [code]"bluetooth"[/code]. A non-zero [param vendor_id] or [param product_id] lists only matching devices.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns the last error message from the HID layer.

method.name: get_feature_report
method.description: Reads feature report [param report_id], up to [param max_size] bytes after the report ID. The first byte of the result is the report ID.

method.name: get_info
method.description: Returns the open device's details, in the same form as [method enumerate].

method.name: get_input_report
method.description: Reads input report [param report_id], up to [param max_size] bytes after the report ID. The first byte of the result is the report ID.

method.name: get_report_descriptor
method.description: Returns the device's HID report descriptor.

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a device is open.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens the device at [param path], as given by [method enumerate].

method.name: open_by_id
method.description: Opens the first device matching [param vendor_id] and [param product_id], and [param serial_number] if given.

method.name: read
method.description: Reads one input report of up to [param max_size] bytes, waiting up to [param timeout_msec] milliseconds ([code]0[/code] returns at once, [code]-1[/code] waits forever). Returns an empty array if nothing arrived.

method.name: send_feature_report
method.description: Sends a feature report. The first byte is the report ID ([code]0[/code] if the device uses none). Returns the number of bytes sent, or [code]-1[/code] on failure.

method.name: write
method.description: Sends an output report. The first byte is the report ID ([code]0[/code] if the device uses none). Returns the number of bytes sent, or [code]-1[/code] on failure.
